title: Darker Lava
description: A Dark mode lava pack to keep your eyes safe
body:
**Dark Mode Lava**
-
This pack is an Overlay to change the Original Lava into a more eye friendly **Darker** one.


This Overlay was made in mind for **Hypixel Skyblock** but essentially can be used for any **Instances**.
